maddeler.e:
أستبصر (form X)
# أَسْتَبْصِرُ (ʔastabṣiru) /ʔas.tab.sˤi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبْصَرَ (istabṣara)
# أَسْتَبْصِرَ (ʔastabṣira) /ʔas.tab.sˤi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَبْصَرَ (istabṣara)
# أَسْتَبْصِرْ (ʔastabṣir) /ʔas.tab.sˤir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَبْصَرَ (istabṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
